key_facts: The Pentagon's counterdrone task force awarded Kaizen Laboratories $15 million to build a two-way marketplace for counterdrone tech.
The contract was awarded on May 8 through an other transaction agreement.
The marketplace is built on an Amazon Web Services backbone and aims to speed up the foreign military sales process.
Australia, Poland, Republic of Korea, Romania, and the United Kingdom are currently approved to use the marketplace.
Mike Obadal, the Army undersecretary, said state and local agencies are also being onboarded to the platform.
